pieces.Text: The waves call to you, like a siren's song echoing across crashing surf. Once the deep one corruption has taken root, the summons calling you to the deep ones' cold, lightless realm becomes a constant thrum in the back of your mind. Exposure to sea water becomes increasingly important to you. Each day that you don't spend at least
hours fully immersed in the ocean or a salt-water sea, you must succeed at a Will save (DC
). You also need to attempt such a Will save whenever you are a target of (or in the area of) a divine spell or spell-like ability with the evil descriptor.
